Subject: Norvell Distribution - Referral Required

Hi Celia,

Thanks for the submission on Norvell Distribution. I have everything needed to review this risk.

However, this account requires referral to senior underwriting due to coastal exposure concerns:

• One location falls within 16 km of the coast
• Our existing portfolio already has high concentration within 25 km of this area

Given our current coastal accumulation limits, this may be challenging for us to quote competitively. I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty coastal market that may have more appetite for this exposure.

I'm happy to discuss further if you'd like, but wanted to give you a quick heads-up so you can explore other options.

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
